task:
System Map hierarchy follow-up (review finding M13, layout quality). Continue on the existing branch `codex/run-41486362567-1` (already merged with main, which added M12's planet-class colours; keep that merge). apps/web only.

WHAT I SAW (Sol, fixture `edfinder_cy`, 1280x900, after your first pass): the schematic layout is correct in structure (moons grouped by parent, orbit-region guides, barycentre crosses, unplaced shelf) but reads badly:
1. All of a parent's children are fanned into a 120-degree sector (`angle = -PI/3 + childIndex/(n-1) * 2PI/3` in `systemBodyLayout`), so Sol's eight planets and their moon regions crowd one side while ~240 degrees of the outer guide circle is empty.
2. The camera starts at semantic range 465 (`Math.max(38, extent * 2.6)` in `buildSystemScene`) because the radial bands reserve each sibling's full descendant region plus log-distance spacing; bodies keep their fixed `displayRadius`, so every planet is a 2-3 px dot and the main star is a speck. Before M13 (main) the same system filled the viewport at range 38 with readable spheres.
3. The outer orbit-region guide (radius = the largest child orbit) is drawn as one huge circle around almost nothing.

WHAT TO DO:
- Spread each parent's placed children around the full circle (golden-angle sequence or even spacing with a per-parent phase from the identity hash), keeping the disjoint radial bands so subtrees never overlap. Keep the unknown-distance shelf explicit but put it on a clearly separate side (not all of one hemisphere).
- Compress the radial scale: bands should grow with the child's own footprint (display radius + rings + its descendants' region) and a modest log spacing, not a multiplier that leaves most of the disc empty. Target: Sol (41 bodies incl. Jupiter/Saturn moon groups) fits at a semantic range near the previous 38-60 with planets at least as large on screen as before M13; a 2-body system still looks like the old layout.
- Scale `displayRadius` for the camera distance where needed (a minimum on-screen size policy, documented) so bodies stay readable; moons may be smaller than their parent but must remain visible and pickable.
- Draw per-parent orbit-region guides at each child's actual orbit radius (thin rings per child, like the pre-M13 orbit rings), not only one enclosing circle per parent; keep the guide for an unknown-distance child absent (no claimed radius).
- Keep every M13 invariant: canonical parent keys, no guessed parents, cycle/overflow handling, unplaced list and legend in SystemDetail, counts, pickable identities; keep M12 colours/bands/unknown-dim. Update `system-layout-bounds.test.ts`, `system-scene.test.ts`, `system-adapter.test.ts` for the new angular/radial policy (bounded extent assertion for a 41-body Sol-like fixture at <= 60 semantic range; siblings not all inside a half-plane; moon regions inside their parent's band and outside the parent's glyph).
- Run `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` in apps/web. Update the existing CHANGES.md M13 entry rather than adding a new one. Still a visual change needing Product E2E validation before promotion; not deployed.
